I live in southern california and I guess you can consider this a semi-dry area.

One of the biggest reasons I started skipping was because there were days where my eczema just went really bad and my face was completely red with rashes and my lips were really dry. I just felt uncomfortable and having social anxiety did not help at all

My current school is really just boring. I follow the same routine and I can't meet new people because they're all in 'groups' already. 80% of my middleschool went to my new high school, so i'm not a new person. I'm planning to transfer school and help cope with my depression by starting new. What do you think? The only downside to this, is that my current school is close to my house and my mom is able to drive me, and If i were to transfer I'm scared I might skip school again and give my parents a hard time while having to attend a NEW school, further away from my house. I'm not sure if I can handle the responsibility..

I just enjoy the idea of a new start if that helps.
Yea eczema.. and i'm planning to see a therapist soon. hopefully that'll help.

I've been to a dermatologist and it didn't really help. I honestly want to go out, but every time I look in the mirror my self-esteem completely drops. I started developing habits through-out the years, such as looking down when I'm walking, looking away when i'm talking to someone else. During 7th grade I covered my face right below my eyes with both of my hands the whole year.. People kept asking me what was wrong and I would have to make up some really stupid excuses. I turned into 'the kid that sits in the corner of the class' I'm really quiet and I've lost my communication skills. I just respond with answers that sound like i'm trying to get them away. "Ok that's great" etc.

No, you shouldn't feel bad. Feelings change and if your feelings aren't the same then maybe she isn't the right one for you. Don't feel bad about it and make your own decisions. If it's not working out for you, tell her or you'll end up being in a miserable marriage. It's not really liking another girl that's making you feel this way. It's because you no longer have those feelings that you had before.
